payload.message: I would like a human colleague to take over my account question. Please arrange follow-up and tell me what happens next.

response.answer:
I've passed your request to a human colleague. Your escalation reference is **1**, and its status is currently **queued**.

Here's what happens next:
- A human support agent will pick up your case from the queue and follow up with you on your account question.
- I don't have a confirmed timeframe for when an agent will respond, so I can't promise one.
- Please keep your reference number (1) handy if you contact us again.

Is there anything else I can note for the agent, such as the specific account question? If you describe it now, I can add it to the case. I can't change the escalation after it's been submitted, but I can open a new one with more detail if needed.
